description: Update page metadata: name, slug, parent and position in the tree, display name, SEO fields and custom fields. Only the languages and fields you pass change - the ones you omit keep their current values. Only call after the user confirms.

customFields.description: Custom field values to set: [{ fieldKey, value }]. Fields you omit keep their current value

displayName.description: Display name for the languages you pass; languages you omit keep their current value

order.description: Position among the siblings under the (new or current) parent, 0-based. Siblings shift to make room; this is the order the page tree and any tree-driven navigation show.

parentId.description: Move the page under a different parent by id (reparent). The full slug path is recomputed from the new parent + this page's leaf segment, and descendant slugs cascade.

seoDescription.description: SEO description for the languages you pass; languages you omit keep their current value

seoTitle.description: SEO title for the languages you pass; languages you omit keep their current value

name: update_page_settings
